t: This is the Carabiniers Memorial, a war memorial in Chelsea. It was made by Adrian Jones, an English sculptor and painter who specialised in animals, especially horses. Before turning to art full time, he spent twenty-three years as an army veterinary surgeon, and that training gave him a deep knowledge of how horses are built. He also created the great sculpture of Peace on her chariot, the Quadriga, on top of the Wellington Arch at Hyde Park Corner. Look at the anatomy in the work, and you are seeing that knowledge at work.
